label: Copy phase, late recall (idx>=3): input fed back is k/o/u/p/r/t/a
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (99.9% of mass), and only from recall_idx 3 on. Rate climbs with absolute step t: about 0 before t=8, about 25% for t>=12, so long sequences (L=8-9) carry most of the mass. Inside that window it is selective for the token being fed back as input, which is the previous output: k is strongest (rate 25%, top activations are nearly all k), then o, u, p, r, t, a. Digit 2 and d/j/f/m fire weakly. It almost never fires when in_tok is the first occurrence of that token, which follows from copy-phase inputs being repeats. It does not fire in the original phase or on the delimiter, and next_out, prev_tok and first_tok change it only weakly. The predicate catches about 86% of activation mass, but many low-magnitude activations on other tokens are missed, and many k/o/u steps in shorter or earlier contexts stay silent.
